Calculate Bayesian Multi-Chain MCMC Double Observer Estimate

Source: R/estimators_bayesian.R
bayesian_conjugate_estimate.Rd

Uses a multi-chain Collapsed Poisson-Gamma-Beta Gibbs Sampler (Data Augmentation MCMC) to sample the joint posterior distribution of latent undetected groups \(f_{0,i}\) and observer detection probabilities across sectors. Supports both `"independent"` (two independent observers) and `"dependent"` (2-pass primary/secondary removal) protocols.

Usage

bayesian_conjugate_estimate(
  both,
  obs1_only,
  obs2_only,
  obs_type = c("independent", "dependent"),
  iter = 2000,
  chains = 4,
  burnin = NULL,
  prior_alpha = 1,
  prior_beta = 0.5
)

Arguments

both

Integer vector of numbers of groups seen by both observers

obs1_only

Integer vector of numbers of groups seen by Observer 1 only

obs2_only

Integer vector of numbers of groups seen by Observer 2 only

obs_type

Character string specifying observer protocol: `"independent"` (default) or `"dependent"`.

iter

Integer number of total MCMC iterations per chain (default 2000)

chains

Integer number of independent Markov chains (default 4)

burnin

Integer number of warm-up/burn-in iterations per chain (default `floor(iter / 4)`)

prior_alpha

Numeric Beta hyperprior shape1 parameter for detection probability (default 1)

prior_beta

Numeric Beta hyperprior shape2 parameter for detection probability (default 0.5)

Value

A list containing the posterior `mean`, `median`, `var`, 95 vectors (`ci_lower`, `ci_upper`), multi-chain convergence diagnostics (`rhat`, `ess`), and full posterior sample arrays (`G_draws`, `p1_draws`, `mu_p1_draws`).
